title: Email the resource people request without losing immediate access

source.ref: Owner all-open-work handoff P1-3 lead-magnet gap; continue all development authorization, 2026-11-14/15.

detail: A valid signed resource request queues one transactional resource copy after successful capture, including an existing contact. The shared outbox and default Frequency sender are reused; suppression is checked first. A Redis claim and opaque address/Space/hour outbox key independently bound the public relay across all resources, including when Redis is absent. No capture, queue or provider failure can hide the signed inline resource or create an inbox-delivery promise. Legacy signed links with no resource retain contact capture with explicit no-resource wording; the maker explains its optional contact-only mode. Returned suppression read errors now honor the helper's existing fail-closed contract. No nurture, campaign schedule, sender masking, SQL or direct provider transport is introduced. Verification uses mocked boundaries and sends no real email; future delivery is only the existing worker handling an explicitly requested resource copy. The new in-process consequence probe failed current main 7a71bf173 at zero deliveries, then passed actual action wiring and sender suppression/dedupe consequences. Existing catalog assertions remain; only the new requested-resource receipt is classified alongside existing transactional exemptions. Focused verification and rendered acceptance remain release evidence, not production activation.
